Title: How to Disable Automatic Game Updates on Nintendo Switch
IntroLines: Want to stop your Nintendo Switch from automatically downloading game updates?
In this video, I'll show you how to turn off automatic updates and how to update games manually.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 1: TURN OFF AUTOMATIC SOFTWARE UPDATES
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, open " System Settings " from the bottom toolbar.
•  Scroll all the way down the left sidebar and select " System " .
•  Scroll down on the right side until you find " Auto-Update Software " .
•  Select it to toggle the setting to " Off " .
•  This prevents games from downloading updates automatically in the background or during sleep mode.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu to confirm your new setting is active.
Sections.Bridge: Whenever you do want to update a game, you can easily trigger the update manually.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 2: HOW TO MANUALLY UPDATE A GAME
Steps: •  First, highlight the game you want to update on your HOME Menu.
•  Press the " + " button on your Joy-Con or controller to open options.
•  Select " Software Update " from the menu.
•  Select " Via the Internet " on the right.
•  If a new update is available, your Switch will begin downloading it.
•  Finally, wait for the download to complete and launch your game.

OutroLines: And that's how you can disable automatic game updates on your Nintendo Switch.
